title: Terms of Subscription - Cancellation and the Cancellation Fee (Community Solar Subscriptions)
content:
**Section 1 - Notice.** A subscriber to Community Solar Subscriptions cancels by giving notice, which takes the subscription from active to cancellation pending. The allocation ends on the notice date plus the plan's notice days, recorded as the cancellation effective date. At the end of the notice period the allocation is removed from the utility's subscriber list and the subscription closes, its close date being the cancellation effective date and its close reason cancelled by subscriber.

**Section 2 - When the fee may be invoiced.** A cancellation fee is invoiced only once the subscription is cancellation pending or closed, as shown by its status in the system record.

**Section 3 - The fee.** A cancellation fee of the plan's cancellation fee amount applies when the notice is given before the term end date, except:
(a) when the notice is given no later than the plan's free-look days, in calendar days, after the allocation date; or
(b) when the plan waives the fee on a move out of the utility's territory, and the premise carries a utility move-out date, and the subscriber has no premise in the same utility to transfer to.

**Section 4 - Closure by the utility.** When the utility closes the subscriber's account with no transfer, the subscription ends and goes from active to closed, with the close date being the date the utility account closed and the close reason utility account closed. Such a subscription carries the same fee rules, with the close date in place of the notice date.

**Section 5 - After the term.** After the term end date the subscription continues on Flex terms under the plan's term-end handling and can be cancelled without a fee.

A cancellation fee raises the net amount Beacon Ridge has invoiced the subscriber.

## Section 3 for notice given before the term end date

| Notice within the free look | Plan waives on move out | Premise carries a utility move-out date | Subscriber has a premise in the same utility to transfer to | Cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | any | any | Does not apply (a) |
| No | Yes | Yes | No | Does not apply (b) |
| No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Applies |
| No | Yes | No | any | Applies |
| No | No | any | any | Applies |

For a closure by the utility, read "close date" for "notice date" throughout the table.

## Dates (hypothetical)

- *Effective date.* Notice given on 10 June with a 90-day notice period: the cancellation effective date is 8 September.
- *Free look, both sides.* Allocation date 3 April 2025 with a 30-day free look: notice given on 3 May 2025 is no later than 30 calendar days after the allocation date, so exception (a) holds; notice given on 4 May 2025 is not.
- *Utility move-out date.* The date on the premise record on which the utility final-billed the premise for the customer's move-out; it is empty while the customer still occupies the premise.
